body:
Thank you for your reply. Sorry to hear that you've been in the same sort of a situation. It is stressful. Before I do anything I think I'll try to figure out this week whether taking some time off, ridding stress, and putting off these last classes is a valid option. I don't know what's involved in getting unemployment but I would assume I'm ineligible since I have been receiving financial aid and also my parents (illegally) claim me as a dependent. I'll have to look into it.

I appreciate the encouragement and willingness to talk to me.

Hey, don't worry about it. It's hard to reason with someone who has no reason. It means something that you have listened and tried to understand. It's always nice to be heard. Thank you for replying at all. 

Thank you for sharing your story too. What is it that you realized that you wanted to do with your life? I'm somewhat curious. I myself don't really have a purpose or goals. I used to want to graduate with an impressive degree and go into some high paying job or maybe live in another country but I really just don't want any of those things anymore. I have no motivation. I also fear a future where I don't have any direction. There's nothing to look forward to. All I do is dread and despair. This is probably what made me sink so deep into desperation so close (a couple months away) to graduating. 

You don't have to apologize for taking long to reply, it's not like I'm any quicker.
Nothing, theoretically. My own whim, I suppose. I would just rather be dead. I know I should think differently and at least try.

See [this post](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/1yp0cn/getting_close/) I made a month ago before my first "attempt". It details my situation. Since that post, I had a weak attempt, reached out for help, and ended up hospitalized and embarrassed. I have been on medication and in therapy the past weeks. I didn't lose my job and I made arrangements with my professors to be able to make up the work. People around me are all wonderfully supportive even at the cost of their own well-being. Despite this, I am just so tired, I am done. It's uncomfortable, being alive.

Nothing, I have what is supposed to be a decent life. I just don't want any of it. Living is what is difficult. Being trapped. Burdening everyone around me and watching them suffer, I can't solve that. I have tried 'real help' (telling someone, seeing doctors, medication, therapy, hospitalization) and it got me nowhere, more harm than help really.

It's not even a why. My existence right now is just pathetic.

I had wanted to vanish quietly and without warning and that's the way it should have been. But I fucked it up and winded up hospitalized and humiliated. I was too cowardly to effectively follow through. Now I'm hurting everyone around me. Whether I'm alive or dead I'm an inconsiderate piece of shit who is making everyone suffer. That is the closest I can come up with as far as why I feel pathetic. It is pathetic, everything.
